title.original: CO2-Meter: A Comprehensive Carbon Footprint Estimator for LLMs on Edge Devices
title.zh: CO2-Meter：边缘设备上 LLM 的综合碳足迹估算器
title.en: CO2-Meter: A Comprehensive Carbon Footprint Estimator for LLMs on Edge Devices

inclusion_reason.zh: CO2-Meter 统一运行能耗、外设和 SoC 隐含碳模型，提供可复用的边缘 LLM 全生命周期碳核算工具。
inclusion_reason.en: CO2-Meter unifies operating energy, peripherals, and SoC embodied-carbon models into reusable lifecycle accounting infrastructure for edge LLMs.

abstract.zh: CO2-Meter 统一估算边缘设备 LLM 推理的运行碳与 SoC 隐含碳，补入外设能耗、预填充/解码差异和芯片单元级制造影响。框架结合公式模型、阶段化能耗数据和 GNN 预测器，用于定位碳热点。
abstract.en: CO2-Meter estimates both operational and embodied carbon for edge LLM inference, including peripheral energy, distinct prefill/decode behavior, and unit-level SoC manufacturing impact. It combines analytical models, phase-specific measurements, and a GNN predictor to locate carbon hotspots.

problem.zh: 既有边缘推理碳估算常忽略外设、推理阶段差异和 SoC 制造构成，因而无法准确归因总碳足迹或指导硬件设计取舍。
problem.en: Existing edge-inference estimators omit peripherals, phase-specific behavior, and SoC manufacturing composition, preventing complete attribution and informed hardware design trade-offs.

approach.zh: 系统为外设建立方程式能耗模型和数据集，用预填充/解码分相数据训练 GNN 能耗预测器，并把芯片单元映射到隐含碳和设计瓶颈。
approach.en: It builds equation-based peripheral models and datasets, trains a GNN on separated prefill/decode energy observations, and maps SoC units to embodied-carbon contributions and design bottlenecks.

system_design.zh: CO2-Meter 的估算流水线接收模型、运行阶段、边缘平台和 SoC 配置，分别计算主芯片与外设运行能耗，再叠加单元级制造碳，输出热点与设计建议。
system_design.en: The pipeline accepts model, inference phase, edge platform, and SoC configuration, estimates device and peripheral operating energy, adds unit-level embodied carbon, and emits hotspot and design analyses.

key_results.zh: 官方摘要报告 CO2-Meter 比既有方法估算更准确，案例能够识别运行与芯片设计中的碳热点并指导可持续优化。
key_results.en: The abstract reports better estimation accuracy than prior methods and case studies that identify operational and SoC carbon hotspots for sustainable design choices.

limitations.zh: GNN 与隐含碳模型依赖训练平台、制造数据库和电网假设；摘要未说明跨新 SoC、不同地区电力结构或设备寿命的校准误差。
limitations.en: The GNN and embodied-carbon model depend on observed platforms, manufacturing inventories, and grid assumptions; calibration across new SoCs, regions, and device lifetimes is not described.

models: large language models on edge devices

notes.zh: 边缘 LLM、分阶段推理、SoC/外设和既有估算器比较来自官方摘要；具名模型/设备、误差指标和碳数值待全文审计。
notes.en: Edge LLMs, phase-specific inference, SoC/peripherals, and comparison with prior estimators come from the official abstract; named models/devices, error metrics, and carbon values await full-text audit.
